title: Local scalar tensor sections and ordinary coefficient pullback
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital ring map. Work with ordinary module sheaves on the small etale sites of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $E_{\varphi,T}$ for ordinary scalar extension [def-sf-etale-sheaf-scalar-extension], and $B_T=\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi,T}(\mathbf 1_{B,T})$ for the constant coefficient sheaf with its restricted $A$-action. For every morphism $e:U\to V$ of schemes, define $c_{\varphi,e}:e_A^*B_V\simeq B_U$ by the ordinary inverse-image/restriction comparison at $\mathbf 1_{B,V}$ followed by restriction of the inverse monoidal unit isomorphism of $e_B^*$, the ordinary coefficient construction used in [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data]. For a scheme $T$, an $A_T$-module sheaf $M$, an etale test object $S$ over $T$, $m\in M(S)$ and an arbitrary local coefficient $b\in B_T(S)$, define $t_{\varphi,M,S}(m,b)\in(E_{\varphi,T}M)(S)$ as follows: take the local tensor-section map of [def-pur-etale-projection-data], then apply the ordinary balancing map $M\otimes_A B_T\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi,T}(E_{\varphi,T}M)$. This balancing map is the scalar-adjunction unit tensored with $B_T$, followed by the lax tensorator of restriction and restriction of the right unitor. These are exactly compactificationCoefficientPullbackIso and compactificationScalarTensorSection, with their existing real-data constructions. No etaleness or finiteness assumption on $e$, and no finiteness, nonzero or flatness assumption on the rings, is imposed.

def compactificationCoefficientPullbackIso
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U V : Scheme.{u}} (e : U ⟶ V) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).obj (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ V) ≅
      scalarCoefficientSheaf φ U
